environment.description: Kubernetes 1.28 cluster with namespace-level Pod Security Standards enforcement. The 'ci-runners' namespace has label 'pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: baseline' applied via a Kyverno ClusterPolicy that mutates namespace labels on creation (policy name: 'enforce-pss-baseline-on-ci'). Additionally, a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy (v1beta1) named 'deny-hostpath-and-privileged' uses CEL expressions: rule 1 checks 'object.spec.volumes.all(v, !has(v.hostPath))' and rule 2 checks 'object.spec.containers.all(c, !has(c.securityContext) || !has(c.securityContext.privileged) || c.securityContext.privileged == false)'. The ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding targets namespace selector 'team: ci'. Note: the baseline PSS level permits hostProcess=false but the additional VAP provides defense-in-depth specifically against hostPath. The cache volume is instead backed by an emptyDir with sizeLimit 2Gi, meaning /var/cache/ci-artifacts resolves to pod-local ephemeral storage only.
